analytical_interpretation.nonrecurring_revenue_warning: The $182M ARC token presale is included in $207.264M other revenue and materially affects reported revenue and adjusted EBITDA growth; do not extrapolate it as recurring reserve income.
analytical_interpretation.rate_sensitivity: Reserve return fell 61 basis points year over year to approximately 3.5%, while reserve income fell 8% despite average USDC circulation rising 8%.
analytical_interpretation.circulation_signal: Average circulation grew, but end-period circulation was flat year over year and USDC market share fell 183 basis points to 27%.
analytical_interpretation.volume_warning: $13.9T is gross on-chain transaction volume per Visa Onchain Analytics (unadjusted); it is not net new capital, unique payments, or XRP demand.
analytical_interpretation.restructuring_warning: A 5% workforce reduction and $9.145M restructuring expense are disclosed; the filing attributes the action to organizational alignment, not AI or distress.
